output.reason: [ev-4fdefdd841ec] says the label was removed (not deprecated) from pods and external listener Services, and tells anyone whose custom setup uses it to switch to `strimzi.io/pod-name`. That is a required operator step for exposed setups, so the class is mandatory work. However, the evidence never says the setup "stops working", which is what workload-failure claims. migration-required, the switch to the replacement label, matches what the evidence actually says.

correction.statement: Strimzi 0.46.0 removed the statefulset.kubernetes.io/pod-name label from pods and external listener Kubernetes Services; custom setups that use this label must switch to the strimzi.io/pod-name label.

consequence.statement: After the upgrade, Strimzi pods and external listener Kubernetes Services no longer carry the statefulset.kubernetes.io/pod-name label, so any custom setup that uses this label must be changed to use the strimzi.io/pod-name label instead.
consequence.remediation: Update any custom setup that uses the statefulset.kubernetes.io/pod-name label to use the strimzi.io/pod-name label instead.
